blocks.text: “This Ain’t About You” is an ongoing photographic project exploring everyday life in Geneva through the fleeting, often unnoticed moments that make up our daily existence.
The series focuses on small, everyday moments of people sharing the same streets. It is a way of being present in the city, rather than trying to explain it.

Geneva is both the setting and a silent participant in the work. A city often perceived through its polished, orderly and international image becomes something more human and unpredictable when observed through these fleeting encounters. The photographs are not intended to provide a definitive portrait of Geneva, but rather to capture the atmosphere of a place through the people who inhabit it.

The title “This Ain’t About” You is deliberately ambiguous. It refers both to the people photographed and to myself as the photographer. The images may appear to be about others, but they inevitably reveal something about the person observing, choosing and framing. In that sense, the project is also an exploration of the photographer’s own position within the world being photographed.

As part of this larger body of work, I recently produced a zine entitled Rive Gauche / Rive Droite. The zine can be seen as a window into the wider project, a self-contained fragment of a much larger photographic exploration of Geneva, its inhabitants and its everyday life.
